details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:121-132 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The ISSUE_META_FILE guard can let an absolute stale path survive when RUNTIME_DIR is empty, so diagnose may read metadata from the wrong run.
  WHY: All reviewers agreed the guard is bypassed in that edge case, though some treated it as a hardening gap because CI normally sets RUNTIME_DIR.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:124-131 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: There is no test covering the rejection path for the new ISSUE_META_FILE guard.
  WHY: Existing tests never exercise an outside-RUNTIME_DIR ISSUE_META_FILE, so a regression in the guard would go unnoticed.
- scripts/validate_driver.sh:159-162 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Empty RUNTIME_DIR expands VALIDATION_SEMBLE_QUERY_FILE to /validation_semble_query.json, which points at filesystem root.
  WHY: The directory check accepts / and the later write is fail-opened, so the artifact is silently lost rather than safely skipped.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:552-561 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The Build Semble index step omits -e, so a non-chained command failure can be skipped instead of aborting the step.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers noted the current && chain makes this mostly harmless today, but the flag inconsistency is still error-prone.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:558-584 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: semble index . has no local timeout, so a hung indexer can block the workflow until the global job timeout.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the step already uses fail-open fallbacks, but without a timeout the job can still burn the full 180-minute budget.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2794-2807 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose prompt describes === SEMBLE: ... === retrieval blocks, but this path emits a VALIDATION SEMBLE QUERY CANDIDATES JSON sidecar instead.
  WHY: Some reviewers said the JSON sidecar is intentional, but others flagged the prompt/implementation contract mismatch because the model is told to expect a different format.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:360-384 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: build_post_codex_semble_block checks only semble_query_block and then calls _semble_sanitize_one_line without its own guard.
  WHY: If the helpers file is only partially sourced, the sanitizer call can fail, though some reviewers argued the same file usually defines both symbols together.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:259-266 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The embedded Python unpacks sys.argv[1:4] without validating that three arguments were passed.
  WHY: The current caller passes three args, but a caller regression would raise before the fail-open wrapper can help.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:6-16 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: _semble_bool_true is duplicated in scripts/install_semble.sh and scripts/semble_helpers.sh, so the copies can drift.
  WHY: Reviewers treated this as maintenance risk rather than a runtime bug, but any divergence would silently change boolean parsing between install and runtime contexts.
- tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py:927-928 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The test hardcodes tmp_path / "diag-repo" for repo_root, coupling it to _prepare_diagnose_repo's current internal directory name.
  WHY: If the helper renames that directory, the test will fail for an unrelated reason even though Semble behavior is unchanged.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:109 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The no-results fallback relies on an exact "No results found." string match.
  WHY: A trailing space or other formatting change from the CLI would skip the fallback, though the issue is low-probability.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/validate_driver.sh:159-162 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Empty RUNTIME_DIR makes VALIDATION_SEMBLE_QUERY_FILE resolve to /validation_semble_query.json.
  WHY: dirname returns /, the directory check passes, and the write at filesystem root fails on normal runners.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2804-2807 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The diagnose prompt emits VALIDATION SEMBLE QUERY CANDIDATES JSON where prompts/mode-validate-diagnose.txt line 9 describes === SEMBLE: ... === blocks.
  WHY: The prompt contract and emitted content diverge, so the model gets query candidates instead of retrieval context.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:124-131 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The new ISSUE_META_FILE rejection path has no test coverage.
  WHY: Existing tests do not set ISSUE_META_FILE outside RUNTIME_DIR, so regressions in the guard would slip through.
- tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py:927-928 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The test hardcodes tmp_path / "diag-repo" for repo_root.
  WHY: That couples it to _prepare_diagnose_repo's internal directory name and can fail for unrelated refactors.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:583-584
  PROBLEM: The indexer has no local timeout.
  WHY: A hung indexer can consume the full workflow budget before fail-open kicks in.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:6-16
  PROBLEM: Keep _semble_bool_true in sync with scripts/semble_helpers.sh:_semble_bool_true.
  WHY: A future drift would silently change boolean parsing between install-time and runtime contexts.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:129-132 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When RUNTIME_DIR is empty, the case pattern "${RUNTIME_DIR}"/* becomes /* and stops excluding outside ISSUE_META_FILE paths.
  WHY: That defeats the guard's purpose of preventing stale metadata from other runs.
- scripts/validate_driver.sh:162 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If RUNTIME_DIR is empty, the default resolves to /validation_semble_query.json.
  WHY: The subsequent directory check uses dirname which returns /, and the script may attempt to write at filesystem root.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:561 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The Build Semble index step uses set -uo pipefail while other workflow steps use set -euo pipefail.
  WHY: Unexpected failures can be silently swallowed instead of triggering the fail-open fallback paths.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:583-584 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The semble index . command has no timeout.
  WHY: A hung indexer can stall the job until the 180-minute workflow timeout.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:6-15 and scripts/semble_helpers.sh:8-17 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Both files define the same _semble_bool_true function.
  WHY: Over time these copies can drift, creating inconsistent boolean parsing.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2804-2807 and prompts/mode-validate-diagnose.txt line 9 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The prompt describes === SEMBLE: ... === blocks but the code outputs === VALIDATION SEMBLE QUERY CANDIDATES === followed by raw JSON.
  WHY: The LLM receives a format different from what the prompt contract specifies.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:124-131 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new Semble guard that clears ISSUE_META_FILE when it points outside RUNTIME_DIR is not exercised by any test.
  WHY: A regression in the guard would silently break stale-metadata protection.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:365-371 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: build_post_codex_semble_block checks for semble_query_block function existence but not _semble_sanitize_one_line.
  WHY: If helpers are only partially sourced, the script can fail on an undefined function.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:259-266 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The embedded Python unpacks exactly three CLI arguments without validating the count.
  WHY: If the shell invocation passes fewer than 3 arguments, Python raises ValueError and aborts the diagnosis flow.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:124-128 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The ISSUE_META_FILE case guard uses pattern "${RUNTIME_DIR}/*" which becomes "/*" when RUNTIME_DIR is empty, allowing any absolute path to pass the guard
  WHY: If RUNTIME_DIR is unset or empty, the guard incorrectly accepts paths like /tmp/stale_meta.json from a prior run, causing diagnose to read wrong issue labels and potentially skip or mis-route fix-up generation
- scripts/validate_driver.sh:162 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If RUNTIME_DIR is empty, VALIDATION_SEMBLE_QUERY_FILE defaults to "/validation_semble_query.json"
  WHY: The subsequent directory check uses dirname which returns "/" for this path, and [ -d "/" ] passes, so the script may attempt to write to filesystem root and fail with permission denied
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:557-558 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "Build Semble index" step uses "set -uo pipefail" omitting "-e" flag used in other workflow steps
  WHY: Without -e, commands that fail with non-zero exit codes will not abort the step, causing silent failures instead of triggering the fail-open fallback paths
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:583-584 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `semble index` invocation has no local timeout wrapper.
  WHY: If the Semble indexer hangs, the job will consume the full timeout before failing open.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:259-266 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The embedded Python unpacks sys.argv[1:4] without validating argument count.
  WHY: If the caller passes fewer than 3 arguments, the list comprehension fails with ValueError and aborts the diagnosis flow.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:360,366 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: build_post_codex_semble_block checks for semble_query_block function existence but not _semble_sanitize_one_line
  WHY: If semble_helpers.sh is only partially sourced, the script calls _semble_sanitize_one_line which may be undefined, causing "command not found" error
- scripts/install_semble.sh AND scripts/semble_helpers.sh:6-16,8-18 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Both files define identical _semble_bool_true helper function
  WHY: The duplicate definitions can drift over time, causing inconsistent boolean parsing between install-time and runtime contexts
- tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py:927 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Test hardcodes tmp_path / "diag-repo" for repo_root path
  WHY: The test depends on _prepare_diagnose_repo maintaining the same internal directory name; if the helper changes, the test fails for unrelated reasons
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:571-575 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The indexer runs without a local timeout.
  WHY: On a large repo or an indexer bug, `semble index .` can hang indefinite
